Junior athletes secure victories in cricket and table tennis tournaments

Two separate junior sports tournaments concluded with victories for young athletes. In a cricket event, KV Golconda clinched the girls' title. Separately, Krishvi Arora emerged victorious in both the Under-17 and Under-19 girls' singles categories at a table tennis tournament.
